summary: Body of missing Pagosa Springs man Jeremiah Villarreal located in Lake Pagosa by the Colorado Parks and Wildlife Marine Evidence Recovery Team during an Archuleta County Sheriff's Office / CBI missing-person investigation; cause of death not publicly released
responding_agency: Archuleta County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Parks and Wildlife Marine Evidence Recovery Team; Colorado Bureau of Investigation
notes: Missing-person investigation opened 2023-04-17 (sheriff requested CBI assistance); body located ~11:55 a.m. 2023-04-18 in Lake Pagosa; discovery date used as incident date; autopsy/cause not publicly released, investigation ongoing; no SAR team mission reported.
